tagline.en: Ai2's Apache-2.0 vision-language-action policy — turn camera views and instructions into robot actions.
tagline.zh: Ai2 的 Apache-2.0 视觉-语言-动作策略——把相机画面与指令转化为机器人动作。

en: MolmoAct2 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy from Ai2 (Allen Institute for AI). It takes camera views and an instruction and predicts robot actions, so instead of generating video it drives a robot policy. The core checkpoints are released under Apache-2.0.

It comes in several profiles tuned for different robots and benchmarks — DROID, bimanual YAM, SO100/SO101, LIBERO, and a Think-LIBERO variant — each with its own camera setup and action space. WorldFoundry runs an in-tree runtime under its action-generation stack, loading the checkpoints through explicit local model and processor classes with remote code disabled, and automatically picks BF16, FP16, or FP32 based on your GPU.
In WorldFoundry you select the profile that matches your robot, point it at the checkpoint, and run the policy-rollout route to get action traces.
zh: MolmoAct2 是 Ai2（艾伦人工智能研究所）推出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它接收相机画面和一条指令，预测机器人动作——因此它不生成视频，而是驱动机器人策略。核心 checkpoint 以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。
它提供多个针对不同机器人与基准调优的配置——DROID、双臂 YAM、SO100/SO101、LIBERO，以及 Think-LIBERO 变体——每个都有各自的相机设置与动作空间。WorldFoundry 在其动作生成栈下运行内置运行时，通过显式的本地模型与处理器类加载 checkpoint（禁用远程代码），并根据你的 GPU 自动选择 BF16、FP16 或 FP32。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你选择与机器人匹配的配置，指向对应 checkpoint，运行 policy-rollout 路径即可得到动作轨迹。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need an openly-licensed VLA policy for robot control — mapping camera input and instructions to actions across DROID, YAM, SO100/101, or LIBERO-style setups.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个开放许可的 VLA 策略来控制机器人时使用——把相机输入与指令映射为动作，覆盖 DROID、YAM、SO100/101 或 LIBERO 类设置。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — its output is action traces, not pixels. Pick the profile that matches your robot, since camera layout and action dimensions differ per profile.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——输出的是动作轨迹而非画面。请选择与你机器人匹配的配置，因为不同配置的相机布局与动作维度各不相同。

en: Profiles for DROID, bimanual YAM, SO100/101, LIBERO, and Think-LIBERO
zh: 出自 Ai2 的视觉-语言-动作策略
核心 checkpoint 采用 Apache-2.0 许可
覆盖 DROID、双臂 YAM、SO100/101、LIBERO 与 Think-LIBERO 配置
按 GPU 自动选择 BF16/FP16/FP32 精度
